SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, ACPT_NO, PO_NO, PO_LNNO FROM V_KEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT, ACPT_NO, PO_NO, PO_LNNO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SDSM' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT AS PLANT , PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , PO_LNNO AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS AS STATUS , MAT_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , ACPT_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE , ACPT_DT AS GR_DATE , ACPT_QTY AS GR_QTY , UNT_PR AS UNIT_PRICE , POR_NO||'-'||POR_LNNO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , RO_QTY , RO_AMT , REMARK FROM V_KEP_GR WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND ACPT_NO = '$G_RS.ACPT_NO$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_LNNO = '$G-RS.PO_LNNO$' ORDER BY PLANT, ACPT_NO, PO_NO, PO_LNNO
UPDATE V_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND ACPT_NO = '$G_RS.ACPT_NO$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_LNNO = '$G-RS.PO_LNNO$'
UPDATE V_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND ACPT_NO = '$G_RS.ACPT_NO$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_LNNO = '$G-RS.PO_LNNO$'
